svg.title: Split Field: the water station after (Split Field 1)
svg.desc: The RCC water station after the attack, wide and still, in ink line and Craftint tone: the tower on four legs with RCC on the tank, its ladder, the dispensing kiosk with its shutter half down and a price board, a barricade of crates, two riot shields lying flat, jerricans on their sides. Eight numbered marks sit on objects; nobody is in the picture.
